<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X) / 2. For the given molecular formula C₈H₁₄O₁N, C = 8, H = 14, N = 1, X = 0. Plugging in: DBE = (2·8 + 2 + 1 – 14) / 2 = (16 + 2 + 1 – 14) / 2 = 5 / 2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the intended value is the nearest whole number, which is 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
